summary.text: Carolyn Essex is a Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Josh Lowenthal.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired City of Los Angeles policy analyst who lives in Long Beach.

paragraphs.text: Carolyn Essex earned a high school diploma from Loma Linda Academy and attended California State University, Los Angeles.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a 12-year resident of Long Beach and a retired City of Los Angeles employee who spent 18 years as a policy analyst in the Community Development Department overseeing Community Development Block Grant funding.

She also said she worked four years in the hospitality industry, 22 years as a caregiver for seniors and children with developmental disabilities, and as a housing coordinator at the Hoffman House, a transitional home for formerly incarcerated women.
Essex advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, she said legislation should prioritize infrastructure and the daily lives of seniors, working families and K-12 students, and she named human and civil rights as her policy passion.
